title: Interactive Log Cabin Murder Mystery Comedy Show
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to the Log Cabin, where the characters are colourful, the clues are questionable and somebody has definitely had a very bad night. This Ottawa-inspired Canadian whodunnit puts you right in the middle of the action. 

You won’t just watch the mystery unfold — you’ll question suspects, follow clues, trade theories and try to solve the crime before the killer is revealed. Expect laughs, surprises, some cheeky PG-13-style innuendo and a very Canadian kind of chaos.
